notes.title: Maintenance release: Godot 3.5.3
notes.notes:
Long time no see, Godot 3!

A maintenance update was long overdue, so here's Godot 3.5.3, with a number of important bug fixes and platform compatibility improvements.

Worth checking out if you have games in production using 3.5.x!
https://godotengine.org/article/maintenance-release-godot-3-5-3/
